unkillable.kills: Thirty_two_reconciles_started_together_yield_exactly_one_200. The Node check-then-set ported literally: safe on one thread, a race on Kestrel's pool
unkillable.why_not_run: Survives: with no await between the read and the write the race window is a few instructions, which 32 concurrent callers do not reliably hit. A test strong enough to catch it would be flaky. check-then-set-with-a-window is the same defect with the window held open, and IS killed, which proves the race test can see the race.
